integrity: Analytic proof establishes continuous-parameter and infinite-limit conclusions. Standalone code corroborates exact rational examples and finite numerical tests. General escort duality and q-exponential shapes are prior results; originality is claimed only for the complete sharp three-level support diagram and nonanalytic critical activation law.
scientific_limitations: Three equally spaced nonnegative capacity scores, exact escort-average equality, and positive Hill orders only. This is a static potential diversity optimization theorem; it is not a population-dynamic extinction theorem. Onset asymptotics are fixed-order, one-sided.
title: Sharp exclusion and activation exponents in a three-capacity escort biodiversity benchmark
